name: magpie-volcengine-plan
description: magpie 供应商插件：火山方舟订阅（Agent Plan / Coding Plan，Anthropic 协议）。只填 AccessKey 就能自动识别套餐、取 API key、读额度和到期；429 额度用尽自动暂停到恢复时间。

scripts.test: node test/plugin.test.mjs && node test/quota.test.mjs && node test/discover.test.mjs

summary.en: Volcengine Ark plan (Agent/Coding) over the Anthropic API. Give it just an AccessKey: it finds the plan, API key, quota and expiry. Pauses an account on quota 429 until reset.
summary.zh: 火山方舟订阅（Agent / Coding Plan，Anthropic 协议）：只填 AccessKey 就自动识别套餐、取 API key、读额度和到期；429 额度用尽自动暂停到恢复时间。
